scenarios.title: A｜酒店
scenarios.setting: 玩家到达酒店办理入住，却发现预订日期是明天。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but your reservation doesn’t start until tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 你想说明预订日期可能选错了，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh no. I think I booked the wrong date.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh no. I think I booked the wrong date.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I must have selected the wrong date when I made the reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I must have selected the wrong date when I made the reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I thought my reservation started today. Could you check it again?

feedback.naturalExpression: I thought my reservation started today. Could you check it again?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Is there any chance I can check in today instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any chance I can check in today instead?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I booked a wrong day.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Oh no. I think I booked the wrong date.
feedback.explanation: 订错日期常说“booked the wrong date”；“the wrong”指与原计划不符的那个日期。

turns.text: Your reservation is for September 9 to September 12.

turns.prompt: 你想补充自己原本想预订的日期，会怎么说？

choices.text: I actually meant to book September 8 to September 11.

feedback.naturalExpression: I actually meant to book September 8 to September 11.
feedback.explanation: “meant to book”说明原本想订的日期，与实际误订的日期区分。

choices.text: Could you change the reservation to start today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you change the reservation to start today?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Do you have a room available tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a room available tonight?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: If I change the dates, will the price be different?

feedback.naturalExpression: If I change the dates, will the price be different?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

turns.text: We do have a room available, but the rate is slightly higher tonight.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: How much would it be in total?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much would it be in total?
feedback.explanation: “in total”指合计，强调所有项目加在一起的数额。

choices.text: Could you keep the rest of my reservation the same?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you keep the rest of my reservation the same?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: That’s okay. I’d still like to check in today.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. I’d still like to check in today.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: That’s more than I expected. Are there any cheaper rooms available?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s more than I expected. Are there any cheaper rooms available?
feedback.explanation: “than I expected”把实际结果与自己的预期作比较，能清楚说明差异。

scenarios.title: B｜机票
scenarios.setting: 玩家检查第二天的行程时，突然发现机票日期订错了。

turns.prompt: 你想向客服说明机票日期订错了，会怎么说？

choices.text: I just realized I booked my flight for the wrong date.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just realized I booked my flight for the wrong date.
feedback.explanation: “I booked”交代原先的预订，适合核对实际安排是否一致。

choices.text: I accidentally selected the wrong travel date when I booked my ticket.

feedback.naturalExpression: I accidentally selected the wrong travel date when I booked my ticket.
feedback.explanation: “I booked”交代原先的预订，适合核对实际安排是否一致。

choices.text: My flight is booked for Friday, but I actually need to travel on Thursday.

feedback.naturalExpression: My flight is booked for Friday, but I actually need to travel on Thursday.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I’d like to see if I can change the date of my flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to see if I can change the date of my flight.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I bought my flight on a wrong date.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just realized I booked my flight for the wrong date.
feedback.explanation: 订错日期可说“booked my flight for the wrong date”；“on a wrong date”可能被理解成购票当天不对。

turns.text: Let me check your booking. Do you have your confirmation number?

turns.prompt: 关于「订错日期」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes. It’s QF82L7.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It’s QF82L7.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Sure. Let me pull it up.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Let me pull it up.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Yes. I have the booking confirmation here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I have the booking confirmation here.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

turns.text: There are still seats available on Thursday’s flight.

turns.prompt: 你想询问改签到目标航班的可能性和费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I change my ticket to that flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I change my ticket to that flight?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: How much would it cost to change it?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much would it cost to change it?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: Would I need to pay the fare difference?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would I need to pay the fare difference?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Are there any other flights available that day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any other flights available that day?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

turns.text: There may be a fare difference depending on the flight you choose.

turns.prompt: 你想了解更改机票的经济方案和费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you tell me the cheapest option?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me the cheapest option?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Okay. What would the total additional cost be?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. What would the total additional cost be?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Could you check the morning flight as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check the morning flight as well?
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

scenarios.title: C｜尝试修改
scenarios.setting: 玩家通过客服尝试修改已经订错的行程。

turns.text: What would you like to change about your booking?

turns.prompt: 关于「订错日期」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to change the dates, if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change the dates, if possible.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I made a mistake when I booked, and I need to move the reservation forward by one day.

feedback.naturalExpression: I made a mistake when I booked, and I need to move the reservation forward by one day.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I’d like to change the booking from September 9–12 to September 8–11.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change the booking from September 9–12 to September 8–11.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: Could you check whether my booking allows date changes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether my booking allows date changes?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: I want to modify my booking time.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to change the dates, if possible.
feedback.explanation: 改住宿或旅行日期时用“dates”更清楚；“time”可能被理解为一天中的钟点。

turns.text: Your booking can be changed, but there’s a change fee.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: How much is the change fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much is the change fee?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: Is there also a difference in price?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there also a difference in price?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Would it be cheaper to cancel and make a new booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be cheaper to cancel and make a new booking?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: If I change it now, will everything else stay the same?

feedback.naturalExpression: If I change it now, will everything else stay the same?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

turns.text: The change fee is $30, and you’ll also need to pay the difference in price.

turns.prompt: 你想确认修改预订所需费用，再决定是否办理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Could you tell me the total before I confirm the change?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you tell me the total before I confirm the change?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: That’s fine. I’d like to go ahead with the change.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’d like to go ahead with the change.
feedback.explanation: “go ahead”表示请继续或可以开始，让对方知道自己准备好了。

choices.text: That’s more than I expected. Let me think about it first.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s more than I expected. Let me think about it first.
feedback.explanation: “than I expected”把实际结果与自己的预期作比较，能清楚说明差异。
